BrochureContent.Content:
No. 202 Lurgan Park is a brilliantly located 3 bedroom residence close to every facility, ATU, Merlin Park Hospital, shops, schools, church, and Ballyloughane Beach. The property also enjoys easy access to Parkmore and Mervue Business Park and many other employment hubs. 

No. 202 offers spacious and comfortable accommodation throughout and incorporates oil fired central heating, double glazing, an excellent kitchen, superb bathroom, and a very spacious side entrance space. Suitable for possible extension in desired. Excellent off street parking. Lovely south facing rear gardens, a real suntrap.

Comprising: sitting room with open fireplace, dining room/ family room with solid fuel stove, excellent fully fitted kitchen includes fridge, dryer, dishwasher. 3 superb family sized bedrooms, all with built in units, and superb main bathroom WC and WHB. Lovely private gardens with a southerly aspect and a rear garden shed.

No. 202 Lurgan Park is a top class home in one of Galway's most popular localities and viewing of this lovely home is highly recommended.

Full details with John Quinn. 091 569 174.
